description: Organize the scores of the linked account with tags, in ONE batch applied whole or not at all (at most 500 changes, counting the tags add creates): create_tags creates tags, add puts a tag on a score (creating the tag if the account has none of that name; names compare without case), remove takes it off, delete_unused_tags deletes tags no score carries. It never renames, deletes or changes a score, and no score's date moves. The opposite changes reverse an organizing (remove what add put, delete_unused_tags for the tags it created). Needs the account linked.

score.description: The score's id, as list_my_scores gives it.

delete_unused_tags.description: Tags to delete if no score carries them, by name.
